title: Recasting Visual Language Models as EEG Foundation Models for Clinical Neurodiagnostics
abstract: arXiv:2611.05538v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Historically automated electroencephalography (EEG) systems was done using task-specific supervised models trained on purposely annotated data. A more recent modeling paradigm relies on creating a unified representation, or a 'foundation model', for multiple modality-specific tasks through large-scale domain-specific pretraining on the unannotated EEG signal. The quality of this unified representation directly depends on the availability of the modality-specific datasets. At the same time, generalist Vision Language Models (VLMs) exhibit broad few-shot learning capacities as well as good fine-tuning adaptability to different visual and language tasks. Can VLMs learn how to read and interpret EEG visually, emulating to a degree the way human clinicians inspect the EEG patterns? translated_title: 将视觉语言模型重塑为用于临床神经诊断的脑电图基础模型
translated_abstract: 历史上，自动化脑电图（EEG）系统是通过在专门标注的数据上训练特定任务的监督模型来实现的。较新的建模范式则依赖于对未标注的脑电信号进行大规模领域特定预训练，从而为多个特定模态的任务创建统一表示，即“基础模型”。这种统一表示的质量直接取决于特定模态数据集的可获得性。与此同时，通用视觉语言模型（VLM）展现出广泛的少样本学习能力，以及对不同视觉和语言任务良好的微调适应性。那么，视觉语言模型能否学会以视觉方式阅读和解读脑电图，在某种程度上模拟人类临床医生检查脑电模式的方式？在这项工作中，我们论证了它们可以做到：我们展示了未经大规模脑电图预训练的通用视觉语言模型，在一系列临床神经……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该研究证明，无需大规模脑电预训练的通用视觉语言模型能够像临床医生一样以视觉方式解读脑电信号，并在临床神经诊断任务上取得有竞争力的表现，从而为构建脑电图基础模型提供了摆脱对大规模脑电数据依赖的新范式。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates that generalist Vision Language Models, without large-scale EEG pretraining, can visually read and interpret EEG signals much like human clinicians, performing competitively on clinical neurodiagnostic tasks and offering a new paradigm for EEG foundation models that reduces reliance on modality-specific datasets.
